title: Schema: Discovering Unknown Environments via Agentic Program Induction
abstract: arXiv:2609.39140v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning to complete tasks in unfamiliar environments with unknown rules remains a key challenge for LLM agents. Current LLM agents often record their discoveries in prose, which may not provide a compact, explicit account of how the environment works. Inspired by how scientists organize observations into testable, predictive theories, we introduce Schema, an agent harness that organizes learning and action through interactive program induction. The LLM agent decides what to investigate and how to act, expressing its evolving understanding of the environment as executable programs. The harness consists of a persistent program workspace and a small set of interfaces for checking these programs against the interaction history, planning within them, and executing plans under step-by-step verification. Schema raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE from 58.7% to 99.2% with the same base model, solves 100% of the public DiG-bench games, and reaches the median

translated_title: Schema：通过智能体程序归纳发现未知环境
translated_abstract: 学习在规则未知的陌生环境中完成任务，仍然是LLM智能体面临的关键挑战。当前的LLM智能体通常以散文形式记录它们的发现，这可能无法提供关于环境如何运作的紧凑、明确的描述。受科学家将观察组织成可测试、可预测的理论的启发，我们提出了Schema——一个通过交互式程序归纳来组织学习与行动的智能体框架。LLM智能体自行决定调查什么以及如何行动，并将其对环境不断演化的理解表达为可执行程序。该框架由一个持久化的程序工作区和一小组接口组成，这些接口用于根据交互历史检查这些程序、在程序内进行规划，以及在逐步验证下执行计划。在相同基础模型下，Schema将ARC-AGI-3的RHAE从58.7%提升至99.2%，解决了100%的公开DiG-bench游戏，并达到了中位数（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: Schema让LLM智能体将对未知环境的理解表达为可执行程序并通过交互式程序归纳不断验证和规划，在相同基础模型下将ARC-AGI-3性能从58.7%提升至99.2%，并完全解决了公开的DiG-bench游戏。
